known_interactions: #158 changes apple_plane_init() to take both supports_xrgb2101010 and an interchange argument; #157 edits plane.c nearby. The dry run is clean but the build is the real check.
#158 does not advertise Interchange framebuffer formats on H17P firmware; not relevant to the J314S.
0002 touches dcp.c and dcp-internal.h, which 0001 also edits; the hunks do not overlap but apply order is 0001 then 0002.

0002 changes dcp_tb_release_locked(): a timed-out release is now treated as complete. This is the riskiest line; it relies on the firmware being unreachable, not merely slow (the failure seen was six consecutive 1 s timeouts, then every later call timing out).

0002 (skip a DCP whose DPTX times out) and 0003/0004 (route a DP-alt port only after HPD / take over a pipeline held without it) both modify dcp-fabric.c. They apply cleanly in order; semantic interaction and KUnit coverage are unreviewed.
Upstream PR #163 is not carried: it fixes the same tipd bug as 0005 and conflicts with it.
